bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
db="$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=deploy --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=postgres --format '{{.Names}}' | head -1)"
test -n "$db"
{ echo PR47_PROFILE_DB_READBACK
docker exec "$db" psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT board_key, purpose, chat_id, message_thread_id, title, enabled FROM posting_topics WHERE chat_id IN (-1003847210571,-1002373696859,-1003770334893) AND (purpose='profile' OR title ILIKE '%プロフ%') ORDER BY board_key,purpose,topic_id LIMIT 30;"
echo FEATURE_GATE
docker exec "$db" psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT feature,enabled,approved_by IS NOT NULL AS approved,length(source_commit)=40 AS source_ok,length(trim(ci_evidence))>0 AS ci_ok,length(trim(gserver_runtime_evidence))>0 AS runtime_ok,length(trim(telegram_e2e_evidence))>0 AS e2e_ok FROM gaybbs_feature_release_gates WHERE feature='profile';"
} | gh issue comment 4 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
